research.facts:
Leclerc Cleared for Madrid
**Key verified facts (HIGH confidence):**
- Leclerc crashed at Parabolica on Lap 2 (Lap 3 by some reports) of Italian GP — fought with Piastri, lost rear
- 23G deceleration on impact with tyre barrier
- Reported blurred/impaired vision in right eye post-crash
- Underwent further medical imaging in Monaco (Monday, Sept. 7)
- Ferrari doctor Dr. Isabel Ornaque (Madring medical director) required neurological clearance
- Charles Leclerc has passed all medical checks and will race in Madrid
